src: UPSC CSE Prelims 2026
s:
The Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) recently introduced a national standard to test and assess bomb disposal systems.
Which of the following statements is/are correct?
1. The new standard is known as IS 19445:2025.
2. It will improve interoperability of equipment across agencies.
3. It was developed by TBRL, DRDO in collaboration with the 30th Central Scientific Research Institute, Russia. Select the answer using the code given below:
x: IS 19445:2025 is BIS's first national standard for testing bomb disposal systems (blankets, baskets, inhibitors), and it brings uniform evaluation that improves interoperability across agencies (1 and 2 correct). It was framed by BIS at the request of the MHA and TBRL (DRDO), with TBRL convening the panel; no Russian institute was involved, so 3 is wrong.

src: UPPSC 2019
s: The National Programme launched on 10th October, 2019 by the Indian Government to encourage talented children to enrich their skills is
x: DHRUV, the Pradhan Mantri Innovative Learning Programme of the HRD Ministry, was launched on 10 October 2019 at ISRO headquarters, Bengaluru, to identify and nurture talented children. Laqshya, Pratibha and Parivartan are not this programme.

src: APPSC Assistant Telugu Translator General Studies & Mental A
s: National Register of Translators is maintained by ____.
x: The National Register of Translators is maintained by the National Translation Mission (Ministry of Education) at the Central Institute of Indian Languages, Mysuru.

src: APPSC Inspector of Factories, Civil Assistant Surgeons & Fis
s: What is "Watan Ko Jano"?
o: Exchange programme for Youth of Hindi Speaking States India to know about motherland
Exchange programme for Youth of Jammu & Kashmir to know about other parts of India
TV Serial aired on Doordarshan about Indian culture
x: 'Watan Ko Jano' is a youth exchange programme of the MHA with the J&K Government, under which young people from Jammu & Kashmir tour other parts of India to know the country. It is not for Hindi-speaking States, nor a TV serial or a book.

src: APPSC Animal Husbandry Department General Studies & Mental A
s:
Consider the following Statement about 'Kashi Tamil Sangamam'

A. Kashi Tamil Sangamam 2023 was inaugurated by Prime Minister Narendra Modi on December at Varanasi

B. Kashi Tamil Sangamam is aimed to reaffirm and rediscover the age-old links between Tamil Nadu and Kashi

C. During the Kashi Tamil Sangamam 2023, Prime Minister used a Real time AI based translation tool

D. 'Bhasini' that live-translated his Hindi speech into Tamil
Which of the above statement is/are correct?
x: The 2nd Kashi Tamil Sangamam was inaugurated by PM Modi on 17 December 2023 at Namo Ghat, Varanasi (A true); it reaffirms the age-old links between Tamil Nadu and Kashi (B true); and his Hindi speech was live-translated into Tamil by the AI tool Bhashini (C and D true). So all statements are correct; the printed key 'B & C only' wrongly treats A as false.

src: APPSC Fisheries Development Officer, Sericulture Officer, Ag
s: On 22 April 2022, Union Minister for Social Justice and Empowerment, Dr. Virendra Kumar launched Dr. Ambedkar Centre of Excellence at which University?
o: Central University of South Bihar, Bodh Gaya
x: Dr. Virendra Kumar launched the Dr. Ambedkar Centres of Excellence (free UPSC civil-services coaching for SC students in 31 central universities, run by the Dr. Ambedkar Foundation) at Banaras Hindu University, Varanasi, on 22 April 2022.

src: APPSC Degree Lecturers General Studies & Mental Ability 2017
s: Under the 'Wall of Valour' campaign launched by Government of India recently to instill nationalism in students in educational Institutions across the country, portraits of the following persons would be displayed at designated placed in the Institutions?
o: Revolutionary freedom fighters who sacrificed their lives
National leaders who led the country in freedom movement
Religious leaders who led rebellions against foreign rule
x: Under the 'Wall of Valour' (Vidya Veerta Abhiyan, launched by HRD Minister Prakash Javadekar on 2 May 2017), universities put up walls with portraits of the 21 Param Vir Chakra awardees to instil patriotism – not freedom fighters, national or religious leaders.

src: APPSC Fisheries Development Officer, Sericulture Officer, Ag
s: Which Ministry of the Government of India organised the 'Badhe Chalo' Movement under Azadi ka Amrit Mahotsav with events between 5 August and 11 August 2022 across ten cities of India and a Grand Finale on 12 August 2022 at Talkatora Stadium in New Delhi?
o: Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports
x: 'Badhe Chalo' was a youth activation of the Ministry of Culture under Azadi Ka Amrit Mahotsav (from 5 August 2022), with the grand finale at Talkatora Stadium, New Delhi, on 12 August 2022.

src: APPSC Junior Lecturers General Studies & Mental Ability 2020
s: In November 2019, the Government of India approved the establishment of the National Institute for Sowa-Rigpa in
x: The Union Cabinet approved the National Institute of Sowa-Rigpa at Leh (Ladakh) on 20 November 2019, as an autonomous body under the Ministry of AYUSH; Jalpaiguri, Kurnool and Coimbatore are wrong.

src: APPSC Polytechnic Lecturers (S1) General Studies & Mental Ab
s: The Ministry of Culture has initiated a flagship project to create a digital database for artist and their art form. What is the name of the project:
x: The Ministry of Culture's flagship project to build a national database of artists and art forms is the National Mission on Cultural Mapping (2017); its village-mapping project is 'Mera Gaon – Meri Dharohar'. The other names are distractors.

src: APPSC Forest Range Officer Mains Paper-I General Studies & M
s: The First Vande Bharat Express was launched between New Delhi and
x: The first Vande Bharat Express (Train 18, built by ICF Chennai) was flagged off in February 2019 between New Delhi and Varanasi. Katra was the second route; Mumbai and Bhopal came later.

src: APPSC Assistant Director in AP Economic & Statistics General
s: What is the name of the scheme recently launched by Union Government to provide legal assistance to the needy by engaging retired judges / officers?
x: Nyaya Mitra (Department of Justice, April 2017) engages retired judicial or executive officers to help dispose of cases pending over 10 years and to give legal assistance; it now runs under the DISHA scheme. Nyaya Bandhu is the pro bono lawyers scheme; Nyaya Raksha and Nyaya Sahaya are not schemes.

src: APPSC Assistant Executive Engineer (AEE) General Studies & M
s:
As of 10th May 2023, the states with the highest percentage of ODF Plus villages are given below. Identify the INCORRECT match.

I. Telangana - 98.7%

II. Karnataka - 99.5%

III. Tamil Nadu - 97.8%

IV. Uttar Pradesh - 95.2%
x: As of 10 May 2023, among large States Telangana had 100% ODF Plus villages (not 98.7%), Karnataka 99.5%, Tamil Nadu 97.8% and Uttar Pradesh 95.2%, so only I is an incorrect match. (Now over 96% of SBM villages are ODF Plus, 31 Dec 2025.)

src: APPSC Executive Officer Gr-III Endowment Paper-I General Stu
s: In which of the following cities is 'Dr. Syama Prasad Mookerjee National Institute of Water and Sanitation (SPM-NIWAS)' located?
x: SPM-NIWAS (the renamed National Centre for Drinking Water, Sanitation and Quality) is at Joka, Kolkata (West Bengal), under the Ministry of Jal Shakti; the PM inaugurated it on 30 December 2022. Howrah, Siliguri and Malda are wrong.

src: APPSC Various Posts (Civil Assistant Surgeon, Group-IV Servi
s: Which phase of the Inter-Operable Criminal Justice System (ICJS) Project was approved by Government of India in February 2022?
x: On 18 February 2022 the Government approved Phase II of the MHA's Inter-Operable Criminal Justice System (ICJS) project – ₹3,375 crore for 2022-23 to 2025-26, implemented by NCRB with NIC on a 'one data, one entry' basis. Phase I had come earlier.

src: APPSC Assistant Telugu Translator General Studies & Mental A
s: A project providing time-bound skill upgradation for railway employees:
x: Project Saksham (announced November 2017) was Indian Railways' time-bound upskilling drive: all ~13 lakh employees got a week of training between January and September 2018.

src: APPSC Assistant Architectural Surveyor & Deputy Surveyor Gen
s: What is the SMS based service recently launched by Indian Railways?
x: 'Clean My Coach' (launched 11 March 2016 by Railway Minister Suresh Prabhu) lets passengers ask for coach cleaning by SMS to 58888 with the PNR, or by app/web. The other names are distractors.

src: APPSC Forest Range Officer Mains Paper-I General Studies & M
s: Under Swachh Bharat Mission, approximately how many toilets were constructed in rural India in a span of 7 years?
x: Over 10 crore (about 100 million) household toilets were built in rural India under the Swachh Bharat Mission after its launch on 2 October 2014, and all rural areas were declared ODF on 2 October 2019.

src: APPSC Draughtsman (Technical Assistant) Paper-I General Stud
s: Who launched Nayi- Disha initiative which is to reintegrate the school dropouts?
x: 'Nayi Disha – A Path Back to Learning' (May 2025) is a Delhi Police initiative: officers visit dropouts' homes and link them with schools, NGOs and counsellors. It is not a Government of India, CRY or Nanhi Kali scheme.

src: APPSC Endowment Subordinate Service (Mains) Paper-I General
s: Sampada is a facility for e-registration of property documents launched by which State?
x: Sampada (now Sampada 2.0) is Madhya Pradesh's online system for e-registration and e-stamping of property documents – not Gujarat, West Bengal or Delhi.

src: APPSC Junior Assistant cum Typist in Prisons & Correctional
s: Punjab State Government has recently launched a programme of Book Banks to provide
o: Used books are collected from Students and provided to needy students which will help them and also avoid paper wastage through printing new books
To Supply free books to dropout students
All the given options are correct
x: Punjab's Book Bank programme (2017) collects used textbooks from students who have passed and gives them free to needy students, so that new books need not be bought or printed every year. It is not for dropouts only, nor a digital library.

src: APPSC Assistant Statistical Officer & Other Posts General St
s: What is the monthly stipend under the Pujari Granthi Samman Yojana, announced by Arvind Kejriwal in December 2024 for Hindu and Sikh priests?
x: Arvind Kejriwal announced the Pujari Granthi Samman Yojana on 30 December 2024 (an AAP poll promise for Delhi) – ₹18,000 a month to temple priests and gurdwara granthis; registration began 31 December.

src: APPSC Assistant Chemist (AP Ground Water Service, AP Insuran
s: Which Indian state launched the 'Janasevaka' scheme to ensure home delivery of various services like ration cards, senior citizen identity and health cards in February 2020?
x: Karnataka (CM B.S. Yediyurappa) launched 'Janasevaka' on 4 February 2020 in Bengaluru for home delivery of 53 services such as ration cards, senior-citizen ID and health cards; it was modelled on Delhi's doorstep scheme. Kerala, Tamil Nadu and Maharashtra are wrong.

src: APPSC Assistant Telugu Translator General Studies & Mental A
s: Which state cabinet has announced to increase the financial assistance given to the families of martyrs from Rs. 25 lakh to Rs. 1 crore?
x: In July 2019 the Maharashtra cabinet (CM Devendra Fadnavis) raised the aid to families of soldiers killed in war or internal-security duty from ₹25 lakh to ₹1 crore, with effect from 1 January 2019.

src: APPSC Group-IV Prelims General Studies & Mental Ability 2022
s: Which State has started 'Kashi Yatra Scheme'?
x: Karnataka started the Kashi Yatra scheme in 2022 (₹5,000 subsidy to 30,000 pilgrims a year visiting Kashi; launched by CM Basavaraj Bommai on 14 July 2022) – not Gujarat, Odisha or MP.

src: APPSC 2025 Zilla Sainik Welfare Officer in Sainik Welfare Se
s: Digital India, a flagship programme of the Government of India was launched on
x: Digital India was launched on 1 July 2015 (11 years in 2026), so option 3 is correct; 15 August 2015, 26 January 2016 and 22 September 2016 are not its launch dates.

src: APPSC 2025 Forest Beat Officer and Assistant Beat Officer In
s: When was the Digital India Mission launched ?
x: The Digital India programme was launched by PM Narendra Modi on 1 July 2015, so 2015 is correct.

src: APPSC Forest Section Officer (Mains) Paper-I General Studies
s: Government of India's "Make in India" initiative was launched on
x: Make in India was launched by PM Modi on 25 September 2014 to make India a global manufacturing hub; the other dates are wrong.

src: APPSC Endowment Subordinate Service (Mains) Paper-I General
s: In July 2025, what was the initiative announced by P. M. Modi for digitisation of ancient manuscripts?
x: The Gyan Bharatam Mission of the Ministry of Culture (announced in Budget 2025–26; the PM spoke of it in July 2025) aims to survey and digitise over 1 crore manuscripts; its National Manuscript Survey began on 16 March 2026. The other names are distractors.

src: APPSC Group-2 PYQ
s:
Which of the following statements are correct regarding the PURVODAYA scheme introduced by the Government of India in 2024?
I. Aims to improve infrastructure in eastern India.
II. Deals with Buxar-Bhagalpur Expressway.
III. New Delhi-Kolkata Industrial Corridor is being developed under it.
IV. Its primary goal is development of Gujarat State.
x: PURVODAYA (Budget 2024–25) is a plan for the five eastern States (Bihar, Jharkhand, West Bengal, Odisha, Andhra Pradesh), and its Bihar road projects include the Buxar–Bhagalpur expressway, so I and II are correct. The corridor under it is the Amritsar–Kolkata Industrial Corridor (node at Gaya), not a 'New Delhi–Kolkata' corridor, and Gujarat is not covered, so III and IV are wrong.
